snippet.title: Age of Empires IV: Dynasties of the East Trailer
snippet.description:
The Battle Evolves. Dynasties of the East is a bold new expansion for Age of Empires IV, introducing four variant civilizations, each with unique units, tech trees, and strategic flavor inspired by real-world Eastern dynasties.

This expansion also introduces The Crucible, a new roguelite RTS experience built for replayability. Players face unpredictable enemy waves, randomized objectives, and unlockable upgrades. No two matches are the same, and each decision shapes the path forward. Whether you're defending your Wonder, unlocking powerful Perks or testing your endurance, The Crucible delivers a fresh twist on traditional Age of Empires IV gameplay.

Pre-Order today! Age of Empires IV: Dynasties of the East arrives on November 4th, 2025.
